rejection_reason: Pengman requires the entire single-host Script to avoid invented dialogue, quoted lines, and X says or X asks passages.
script_text:
Scorpio and Gemini are one of the hardest zodiac pairings. They can care about each other and still clash all the time.

Scorpio asks, "What are we doing?"

Gemini says, "Why do we have to decide right now?"

Most people assume that's always how it goes. It's not.

Sometimes Gemini is trying to book the trip or figure out what comes next, and Scorpio says, "Give me a minute."

Whoever wants the answer starts thinking, "You don't take us seriously." Whoever feels pushed starts thinking, "You're trying to control me."

If you're a Scorpio-Gemini couple, tell me which one you are: "Where is this going?" or "Can you give me a minute?"
